values:
Day 1
Training
Lower Body:
A1. Frog Hold x 30s hold x 3 sets, rest 30s
*light contraction into the floor
A2. Lateral Squat x 6 reps per side x 3 sets, rest 30s
*light loading if needed
A3. Copenahgen Plank w/ Eccentric Focus x 2-5 reps per side x 3 sets, rest 90s
*midlever

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nPemY29C6c0
*copenhagen

Deep Tier Plyo
B. Deep Tier Oscillating Split Squats: 3 x 6 reps per side, rest 1 minute.
*same intention as last week - building in height over the reps

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/DwkgG0QFxbQ

C. Split Squat : 5 x 6 reps per side, rest 30s b/t sides, rest 1 minutes.
*25-30#/hand across the sets

D. Kickstand RDL: 3 x 10 reps per side, rest 30s b/t sides, rest 2 minutes.
*20-25# in contralateral hand

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/B_aj-kU9pUs

Upper Body:
A. Supine Band ER Hold: 3 x 20-30s hold, rest 40-60s.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJZ_ACl41Pg

B1. Quadruped Scap Push-up x 6-8 x 3 sets, rest 10-20s
B2. Chest Supported T Raise x 10 reps x 3, rest 1-2 minutes.
*pinky leads / 8-10#

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/B2YYOU_q0cw
*scap push-up

C. Half Kneel Landmine Shoulder Press (2011): 3 x 10 reps per side, rest 2 minutes.
*empty bb or add 5-10#
+
D. Single Arm Horizontal Cable Row: 3-4 x 8 reps, rest 2 minutes.
*60#+

Day 2:
Lower Body:
A1. Elevated Pigeon Stretch x 20-30s hold per side x 3 sets, rest 20s
A2. Couch Stretch x 30s w/ intermitten active contraction into bench x 3 sets, rest 90s

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1x_x97fRJiY
*pigeon

B. Front Squat: In 5 sets, build to a challenging 3.
*this is not a 3RM, this is just something heavy you feel confident moving.
+
Plyo Progression:
C. Light Tier Leap + Tuck Jump: 3 sets x 2-5 complexes (2+1), rest as needed.
*You don't have to be super aggressive on the tuck jump yet. Just working on leaving the ground a bit higher and getting your knees up.
D. Medium Tier Leaps - lateral: 3 x 3-6 reps per direction, rest as needed.
E. Medium Tier Hop (single leg): 3 sets x 3-5 reps per side, rest as needed.

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7aoP4KTzw1A
*can be stationary like this or forward traveling (medium tier hop)

Run/Walk Progression:
F. 18-20 Sets:
30s Run @ 60 minute effort (~12:30/mile)
30s Walk

Upper Body:
A1. 90/90 ER Walkout Hold x 20-30s hold x 2-3 sets, rest 30s
A2. DB External Rotation Eccentric (only) x 3-5 reps x 2-3 sets, rest 2 minutes
*around 20# - around a 5s eccentric

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-T-CWoaF6B0
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JQHttlGoDic

B. Strict Pull-up: 4 x 3.2.1, rest 20s b/t clusters, rest 2 minutes.
*general control over the eccentric

C. Lat Pulldown: 3 x 12 reps, rest 2 minutes.
*8-8.5/10 RPE 

D1. DB Skull Crushers x 12 reps x 2-3 sets, rest 60s
D2. DB Supianted Bicep Curls x 12 reps x 2-3 stes, rest 90-120s

Day 3:
Lower Body:
A1. Arm Assisted Hip Airplane x 3 reps per side x 2 sets, rest 30s
*Make sure the motion is coming from the hip rotating on the stationary leg
A2. Copenhagen Plank Cross Connect x 4-8 reps per side x 2 sets, rest 60s

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/V4HCZjxfpak
*hip airplane
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=soojb4A9-i4
*cross connect

B. Hip Flexor Sit (eccentric focused): 3 x 12 reps per side, rest 90s.
*lean back as far as you feel comfortable, the goal is to load the quad/hip flexor that is attached to the db

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/x-HXft5pgIM

C. Clean Grip RDL (20x1): 4 x 6 reps @ 8/10 RPE, rest 2 minutes.

D. Single Leg Shoulder Elevated Hip Thrust: 3 x 15 reps per side, rest 1-2 minutes.
*These are deceivingly hard.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C2SCkVk4Atc

Upper Body:
A. Supine Band ER Hold: 3 x 20-30s hold, rest 40-60s.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJZ_ACl41Pg

B1. Quadruped Scap Push-up x 6-8 x 3 sets, rest 10-20s
B2. Chest Supported T Raise x 10 reps x 3, rest 1-2 minutes.
*pinky leads / 8-10#

C. 1+1/4 DB Bench Press: 5 x 6 reps @ 8/10 RPE, rest 60-90s.
*About the same volume as last time, just different set up to get a different exposure. Still control the db around the shoulder

D1. Thoracic Bridge w/ Crab Reach x 3-5 reps per side x 3 sets, rest 30s
D2. Prone Victorian Raise x 8 reps x 3 sets, rest 90s
*10#

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bbLoxClXMro
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1gUuXj0hjcc

Day 4:
Lower Body:
A1. Frog Hold x 30s hold x 3 sets, rest 30s
*light contraction into the floor
A2. Elevated Pigeon Stretch x 20-30s hold per side x 3 sets, rest 90s

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1x_x97fRJiY
*pigeon
+
B. Depth Drop + Light Tier Double Leg Leap: 3 x 3-5 reps by singles, rest 1-2 minutes.
*20" box
**You'll step off the box, hit the floor, and small rebound off the ground, then settle into your "athletic" stance.

C. Skater Bound (rebound): 4 x 5-7 reps per side, rest 90s.
*Let's work on some rebounding reps, start with a small distance and be smooth. You don't have to be exploisve yet or try for a large effort. We can build here.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aJzKiPxRFAE

D. Sled Push into Small "Sprint": 3-5 sets x 10-20ft. sled push + 10-20ft. "sprint", rest as needed to keep quality high.
*30-35# on the sled. Focus is still moving with speed/higher effort. Don't let the initial weight be a deterrent

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VwXUkAJPmy8
+
E. Cyclist Goblet Squat (20x1): 3 x 8 reps, rest 2 minutes
*30-35# kb

Upper Body:
A1. 90/90 ER Walkout Hold x 30s hold x 2 sets, rest 30s
A2. DB External Rotation Eccentric (only) x 5 reps x 2 sets, rest 2 minutes
*15#

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-T-CWoaF6B0
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JQHttlGoDic

B. BFR DB Powell Raise: 3 x 12 reps, rest 90s.
*5#

C1. Single Arm Tricep Extension x 12 reps per side x 3 sets, rest 30-45s
*4-6# on cable
C2. Wide DB Bicep Curls x 10 reps x 3 sets, rest 90s

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/SQzHwnw6-6g

***IF time/energy remains:
Conditioning:
A. Bike Erg:  5 sets x 6 Minute @ 2:08-2:10/1k, rest 2 minute.
*damper 3-4
